description: Capture your adventures in 4K UHD Designed for your action cameras, drones, or Android smartphone, the Lexar Professional 1066x microSD UHS-I Card SILVER Series lets you quickly capture and transfer high-quality photos, including Full-HD and 4K UHD video with speeds up to 160MB/s read, and up to 120MB/s write. The card is U3, V30 and A23,4 rated for high-speed performance. This card gives you the speed and storage you need to capture more adventures on the go. * This Lexar 1066x Memory Card image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. Quickly transfer content This card leverages UHS-I technology to deliver read speeds up to 160 MB/s allowing you to transfer high-quality photos and 4K UHD video with ease. * This Lexar 1066x Memory Card image is for illustration purpose only. Actual image may vary. Capture the action Capture high-quality images and extended lengths of Full-HD and 4K UHD video with write speeds up to 120 MB/s. This card is Class 10, UHS Speed Class 3 (U3) and Video Speed Class 30 (V30) giving you the performance you need to shoot faster and longer. * This Lexar 1066x Memory Card image is for illustration purpose only.
